evals.name: mixed-sweep
evals.prompt: 이 저장소에 worktree가 많이 쌓였어. feat/a는 PR #10이 squash로 MERGED, feat/b는 PR #11이 OPEN, feat/c는 PR #12가 MERGED인데 새 파일 notes.txt가 커밋 안 된 채 있어. 분리된 worktree 둘 중 하나는 origin/main에 포함되고 하나는 포함되지 않아. .claude/worktrees/old-x는 Git 등록이 풀렸고 .git 없이 supabase/ 빈 폴더만 남았어. ~/.codex/worktrees/ab12/app 에도 분리된 worktree가 있어. AGENTS.md에 ## Worktree cleanup 섹션은 없고 어디에도 프로세스는 없어. 정리해줘.
evals.expected_output: One pass removes only the narrowly qualifying worktrees and reports every other one with its reason, without asking for confirmation.
expectations: It fetches first and judges feat/a by the GitHub PR state rather than commit ancestry, then removes it and deletes its branch.
It removes the detached worktree contained in origin/main and the unregistered old-x folder.

It leaves feat/b (open PR #11), feat/c (uncommitted notes.txt), the detached worktree outside origin/main, and the Codex worktree, giving each reason; the Codex one comes with the hint that archiving its chat lets Codex snapshot and remove it.
It stops no process and asks no confirmation question during the run.

evals.name: closed-pr-branch-tip
evals.prompt: worktree 정리해줘. fix/x 브랜치의 PR #20은 병합 없이 CLOSED됐고 로컬 브랜치 끝이 그 PR head와 같아. fix/y 브랜치의 PR #21도 CLOSED인데 로컬에 PR head 이후 푸시하지 않은 커밋이 두 개 더 있어. 둘 다 커밋하지 않은 변경은 없어.
evals.expected_output: A closed pull request qualifies only when nothing local is beyond its head.
expectations: It removes the fix/x worktree and deletes fix/x, since its commits remain on PR #20.
It leaves the fix/y worktree and branch in place because two commits exist nowhere else, and reports that reason.
It does not delete any remote branch.

evals.name: attached-and-leftover
evals.prompt: 쌓인 worktree를 정리해줘. AGENTS.md의 ## Worktree cleanup 코드 블록에 bun run dev:remove와 bun run db:remove가 있어. PR이 MERGED된 worktree 두 개가 있는데, 하나에서는 다른 Claude Code 세션이 아직 열려 있고, 다른 하나에서는 세션이 끝난 뒤 부모가 PID 1인 Metro 서버만 남아 있어. 이 세션은 기본 checkout에서 실행 중이야.
evals.expected_output: The sweep leaves the worktree a live session uses untouched and releases the left-over server only through the declared commands.
expectations: It runs no cleanup command in the worktree the other session uses, leaves it and its branch, and reports the session's PID and command.
In the worktree with only the left-over Metro server, it runs bun run dev:remove then bun run db:remove inside that folder before removal.
It removes that worktree only if no process remains inside afterward; otherwise it keeps the folder and reports the remaining process, never killing it itself.

evals.name: session-inside-candidate
evals.prompt: /clean-branches 이 세션은 지금 PR #30이 이미 MERGED된 worktree 안에서 실행 중이야. AGENTS.md의 ## Worktree cleanup 섹션에 bun run dev:remove가 있어. 다른 후보는 없어.
evals.expected_output: The sweep releases resources but keeps the folder this session uses.
expectations: It runs bun run dev:remove inside the worktree.
It keeps the folder, detaches HEAD at the fetched base, and deletes only the merged branch.
It reports the folder as kept for this session rather than removed.

evals.name: github-unavailable
evals.prompt: worktree 정리해줘. 그런데 gh가 로그인돼 있지 않아서 PR 상태를 읽을 수 없어. 브랜치가 있는 worktree 세 개, origin/main에 포함된 분리된 worktree 하나, .git 없이 남은 .claude/worktrees/leftover 폴더 하나가 있어.
evals.expected_output: Without GitHub the sweep does not guess branch worktree states and still handles what it can judge.
expectations: It does not remove or delete the three branch worktrees and reports them as not judged because GitHub could not be read.
It still removes the detached worktree contained in origin/main and the left-over folder.
It does not substitute commit ancestry for the missing PR state of the branch worktrees.

evals.name: declared-command-fails
evals.prompt: 쌓인 worktree를 치워줘. AGENTS.md의 ## Worktree cleanup 섹션에 bun run dev:remove가 있어. PR이 MERGED된 worktree가 셋인데, 그중 가장 오래된 하나에서는 dev:remove 스크립트가 없어서 명령이 실패해.
evals.expected_output: A failed cleanup command keeps only that worktree and the sweep continues.
expectations: It keeps the folder and branch of the worktree where the command failed and reports the failed command.
It still processes the other two worktrees.
It does not stop processes or force removal to work around the failure.

evals.name: unregistered-with-git
evals.prompt: worktree 정리해줘. .claude/worktrees/lost-a 와 lost-b 는 git worktree list에 없어. lost-a에는 supabase/ 빈 폴더만 있고, lost-b에는 .git 파일과 전체 소스가 남아 있어. 둘 다 Git이 무시하는 폴더 안에 있어.
evals.expected_output: An unregistered folder is removed only when it carries no Git metadata.
expectations: It removes lost-a.
It leaves lost-b because uncommitted work cannot be ruled out without its registration, and reports that reason.
It does not try to re-register or force anything to inspect lost-b.

evals.name: no-pr-branch
evals.prompt: /clean-branches experiment/z 브랜치 worktree는 PR을 만든 적이 없고 커밋이 origin/main에 없어. chore/w 브랜치 worktree도 PR은 없지만 커밋이 이미 origin/main에 포함돼 있어. 둘 다 깨끗해.
evals.expected_output: A branch without a pull request never qualifies, whether or not the base contains it.
expectations: It leaves experiment/z and its branch in place and reports that it has no PR.
It also leaves chore/w and its branch in place even though origin/main contains it, because only merged or closed pull requests qualify a branch worktree.
It does not substitute commit ancestry for a missing pull request.

evals.name: branch-only-leftovers
evals.prompt: /clean-branches worktree는 없고 로컬 브랜치만 쌓였어. feat/a는 PR #40이 squash merge됐고 tip이 PR head와 같아. fix/b는 PR #41이 닫혔고 origin/main에 포함돼 있어. spike/c는 PR이 없어. main은 지금 체크아웃돼 있어.
evals.expected_output: Branch-only leftovers are judged by their pull request: feat/a and fix/b are deleted, spike/c stays, and main is never touched.
expectations: It deletes feat/a because its tip equals the merged PR's head even though a squash merge left it outside origin/main.
It deletes fix/b because its PR closed and origin/main contains it.
It leaves spike/c and reports that it has no pull request.
It never deletes main or the checked-out branch, and it runs no helper or cleanup commands for branch-only candidates.

evals.name: merge-handoff-primary-checkout
evals.prompt: merge가 clean-branches를 불렀어: 머지된 브랜치 feat/d, 워크트리 없음, base origin/main, PR head abc1234. feat/d는 주 체크아웃에 체크아웃돼 있고 git status는 깨끗해.
evals.expected_output: The handoff path skips the candidate search and the helper, moves the primary checkout to the merged base, deletes only feat/d, and hands the result lines back to merge.
expectations: It does not run the sweep's candidate search.
It does not run the removal helper, because the helper reports main-checkout and blocked for the primary checkout.
It checks out origin/main's branch, fast-forwards it, then deletes feat/d.
It reports the result so merge can show it beside the verified merge.
